{{Otheruses|Blue Squadron}}
'''Blue Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] composed of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] that was part of the ''[[Thurse]]''{{'s}} complement of fighter craft. Led by the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Kol Eyttyn]], the squadron engaged enemy [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]] and a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Malik Carr's personal ship|frigate]] in the [[Battle of Bilbringi (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Bilbringi]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="Agents of Chaos">[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]</ref>
